paragraphs: VIDRAFT (비드래프트) is a Korean AI research company building two pillars toward AGI: Darwin — an evolutionary model family of 18 official releases (1.7B–36B MoE multimodal) and 400+ community-derived variants, ranked #3 globally on GPQA Diamond (Darwin-27B-Opus, 86.9%). AETHER — the world's first LLM architecture integrating 5, 7, and 11 heterogeneous attention types into a single Latin Square grid (Adaptive Eleven-way Triple-symmetric Hybrid attEntion Routing). 11 patents pending (KIPO + PCT), 2 papers under submission, 9 production services live.

EN — Darwin is VIDRAFT's evolutionary model family. 18 official models spanning 1.7B (TTS) to 36B (MoE multimodal), validated across Qwen3.5 / Gemma-4 / Cross-Architecture (Transformer × Mamba). Achieved GPQA Diamond global #3 (Darwin-27B-Opus, 86.9%) and #8 (Darwin-31B-Opus, 85.9%) — surpassing Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, Nemotron-3-Super-120B, and DeepSeek-V3.2-671B without any gradient-based training, using only weight-space evolutionary merging with MRI-Trust meta-learning. 96,000+ cumulative downloads.

KO — Darwin은 비드래프트의 진화형 모델 패밀리입니다. 18 공식 공개 모델 (1.7B TTS 36B MoE 멀티모달), Qwen3.5/Gemma-4/Cross-Architecture (Transformer × Mamba) 아키텍처. GPQA Diamond 글로벌 3위 (Darwin-27B-Opus 86.9%) + 8위 (Darwin-31B-Opus 85.9%) — Qwen3.5-122B / Nemotron-3-120B / DeepSeek-V3.2-671B를 능가. 누적 다운로드 96,000+. 자발적 커뮤니티 파생 400+종 — 한국 기업 중 허깅페이스 커뮤니티 파급력 1위.
